name: Fastwave
body:
Discipline psychokinesis [network]; Level aegis 1, gifted blade 1, marksman 1, psychic warrior 1, sighted seeker 1, tactician 1

MANIFEST

Display mental
Manifesting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target 1 creature
Duration 1 round/level or until discharged
Saving Throw Fort negates (harmless); Power Resistance yes
Power Points 1

DESCRIPTION

This power imbues a surge of kinetic energy to a target, giving it a +2 bonus to initiative count. Augment: For every 2 additional power points spent the bonus to your initiative count increases by 1.
